definitions.explanation: A cooking method where an ingredient — typically a small fish, shrimp, or vegetable — is deep-fried whole without cutting or filleting. Also refers to the resulting dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧アジ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{丸揚|まるあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made whole deep-fried small horse mackerel.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{骨|ほね}→骨：02166_hone⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{食|た}べられる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{丸揚|まるあ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: Since the bones of this fish are edible, it's delicious deep-fried whole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{海老|えび}→海老：02272_ebi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{丸揚|まるあ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}したら→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧、⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{尻尾|しっぽ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧カリッ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{揚|あ}がっていた→揚がる：28726_agaru⟧。
examples.english: When I ordered whole deep-fried shrimp at the izakaya, they were fried crispy from head to tail.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧ (whole, entire) and {揚|あ}げ (frying). The ⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧ prefix emphasizes that the ingredient is cooked whole rather than cut into pieces. Common with small fish, shrimp, and certain vegetables that can be eaten entirely after frying.

The key appeal of {丸揚|まるあ}げ is that the high oil temperature cooks the entire item — including bones, shells, or tough parts — until they become crispy and edible. This makes it a popular way to prepare small fish in Japanese home cooking and izakaya menus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丸揚|まるあ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deep-fry whole
- ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{丸揚|まるあ}げ: whole deep-fried fish
- ⟦{海老|えび}→海老：02272_ebi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{丸揚|まるあ}げ: whole deep-fried shrimp
- カリッ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{丸揚|まるあ}げ: crispy whole deep-fry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{素揚|すあ}げ→素揚げ：17176_suage⟧: plain deep-frying — frying without batter, but the ingredient may be cut or filleted
- ⟦{唐揚|からあ}げ→唐揚げ：04949_karaage⟧: Japanese-style fried chicken — typically uses cut pieces coated in flour or starch
- ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧: tempura — batter-coated deep-frying, usually with cut ingredients
- ⟦{丸焼|まるや}き→丸焼き：21373_maruyaki⟧: whole roasting — the roasting equivalent, cooking something whole over heat
